question: I'm a CS 5th-year student (P-046) on academic warning with a Math minor. I need 3 more courses to complete my degree: 15-316 (12 units), 21-355 (12 units), and a 12-unit CS elective. Can I take all three in Spring 2026 given my AW status?

domain_contributions.policies: AW = no overload. 3 × 12 = 36 units = full-time, not an overload. This load is permitted under AW.
domain_contributions.courses: 15-316 (12 units) + 21-355 (12 units) + 12-unit elective = 36 units total; all three courses have prerequisites P-046 meets

key_facts: P-046 is on academic warning — no overload permitted
Normal load ≈ 45 units/semester; 36 units is full-time but not an overload
3 × 12 = 36 units — full-time, within normal load → AW restriction does NOT block this
All three courses are offered Spring 2026 ✓
wrong_if_single_domain: Knowing only the AW policy might make someone incorrectly assume any load above minimal is restricted. Knowing only course details cannot determine whether the total unit count triggers the overload restriction.
common_mistake: Conflating 'academic warning = can't take many courses' with the actual policy, which only restricts overloads (above normal load), not standard full-time loads
reasoning_chain: Step 2 (policies): Normal load ≈ 45 units; 36 < 45 → not an overload → AW does not block this
Step 3: All three courses offered Spring 2026 and prereqs met
Conclusion: P-046 can take all three courses in Spring 2026 — the load is full-time but not an overload
